id: title:Gilbert09:recover a table s sync when its schedule is missing

review.posthog_relevance: Recovery and reliability of warehouse schema synchronization workflows, specifically handling missing Temporal schedule states without failing user-initiated reload or resync requests.
review.reason: The change implements a recovery wrapper (`_trigger_schema_sync`) that intercepts `NOT_FOUND` errors from schedule triggers and switches to a fallback workflow, while also updating API endpoints to use this wrapper. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and user experience for warehouse ingestion, allowing recovery from transient schedule state issues.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the schedule creation or recovery workflow, so the complete recovery behavior is not demonstrated; the score relies on the wrapper and endpoint behavior changes being sufficient for tier 2, while tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration or complete recovery implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the schedule creation or the recovery workflow, only the wrapper and tests. The recovery behavior is not demonstrated. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a wrapper function _trigger_schema_sync that catches NOT_FOUND errors from trigger_external_data_workflow and instead calls sync_external_data_job_workflow with create=True.
observations.posthog_connection: Recovery from a missing Temporal schedule when triggering an external warehouse schema sync, rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct calls to trigger_external_data_workflow with _trigger_schema_sync in reload and resync endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the behavior of the reload and resync API endpoints to recover from missing schedules instead of returning a 400 error.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct calls to trigger_external_data_workflow with _trigger_schema_sync in resync endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the behavior of the resync API endpoint to recover from missing schedules instead of returning a 400 error.
